description: Classic three-tier web application on AWS with public ALB, private ECS Fargate API tier, RDS PostgreSQL in isolated subnets, S3 for static assets, and VPC endpoints to keep AWS API traffic off the public internet.
constraints: No public RDS or ECS task ENIs
TLS termination at ALB with modern cipher policy
IAM roles per service — no long-lived access keys
Encryption at rest on RDS and S3
requiredCapabilities: Amazon VPC with public and private subnets
assumptions: Single primary region; multi-region DR handled in a separate exemplar
Moderate traffic suitable for Fargate without EKS overhead
